Subject: Joint opportunity mapping & GCP co-sell prep for Northstar Health

Hi Alicia / David —

Thanks again for the intro, Alicia. Per our call last week, Northstar’s evaluation looks like it could close into a pilot if we align on a joint go-to-market approach with GCP partner channels. Would GCP be open to a short joint pipeline review next week so we can map mutual motion, eligibility for co-sell credits, and identify any missing procurement blockers?

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- Quick intros and decision owners (5m)
- Northstar opportunity profile + timeline (10m)
- Co-sell eligibility checklist / documentation needs (5m)
- Next steps + owner assignment (10m)

I’ve attached a draft pipeline spreadsheet and a co-sell checklist to speed the sync. Vanessa and Karthik from my team are looped in — Vanessa will lead the partner ops side and Karthik will own GCP technical readiness.

When works for you? I’m suggesting Tue 23rd 10–10:30am PT or Wed 24th 2–2:30pm PT.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Soojin — Tue 23rd 10am PT works for our team.

Quick notes on the opportunity:
- Use case: clinical summarization + triage assistant for outpatient intake (PII within scope).
- Timeline: decision in late Q2, pilot in early Q3.
- Sponsor: Maria Lopez (VP Clinical Ops) — procurement will need SOC2 evidence + DMZ network diagram.

David — can you confirm whether Northstar would meet GCP co-sell criteria once we surface the SOC2 and a Letter of Intent? Also happy to share our internal SOW draft ahead of the call.

Appreciate it,
Alicia

Thanks for the fast turn, team. Couple of pre-read items from SE side: 
- Data residency and encryption: Northstar should expect per-tenant encryption at rest, and we can provide KMS integration details for their HSM. I attached a short note in the Drive (tab: Security_notes).
- Latency target: they mentioned real-time triage — would like to confirm acceptable P95 latency for inference and JV throughput for pilot (suggest 200ms P95, 10QPS).
- Pilot sizing: recommend 1 x A100-equivalent allocation for a 90-day pilot; dedicated or burstable depends on SLA.

Ben
